clause_text: Post-termination non-compete is limited to direct competitors in the same product category within the same country for 6 months.
IP assignment covers only work directly related to company projects. Side projects unrelated to company business are excluded.
Either party may terminate for material breach with 14 days written notice and opportunity to cure within that period.
Confidentiality obligations survive termination for 5 years. Standard carveouts for publicly available and independently developed information apply.
Each party's aggregate liability is capped at 12 months of fees paid. Cap applies equally to both parties.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York. Disputes resolved in federal courts of New York.
Contractor indemnifies client for all losses, costs, and expenses without any cap or limitation on the indemnity obligation.
Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual consent. Seat of arbitration shall be Mumbai.
Salary is fixed for the contract term and may not be reduced without employee's written consent.
Employee shall not recruit or solicit Company personnel for 12 months after termination within the same city.
Only the Company may invoke force majeure. Employee performance obligations continue uninterrupted under all circumstances.
Neither party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence shall be limited or excluded.
All warranties express or implied including merchantability and fitness for purpose are hereby disclaimed in their entirety.
All personal data processing complies with DPDP Act 2023. Data is not shared with third parties without explicit consent.
Employee may not assign any rights or obligations under this agreement. Company may assign freely without restriction.
Agreement terminates automatically at end of term. Parties must negotiate and execute a new contract for any extension.
No severance is payable if employee is terminated for cause or resigns voluntarily under any circumstances.
Vendor grants audit rights to client upon reasonable notice. Audits limited to compliance verification only.
